how: Rules for scripts/check_public.py (lib/privacy.py), run at the end of every update. keys: JSON keys only raw exports carry; a public file holding one is flagged. allow: known false positives, each with why; match by file glob plus key, exact text, or sha (first 12 hex of sha256, so the rule never spells out the value). skip: files not checked (ciphertext).

allow.why: Jack's own contact line; on main before the rebuild
Vercel's DNS records for the domain
a band name made of dotted digits
an artist whose name is a phone number
an artist in the Spotify history whose name is also a call-log contact; it comes from Spotify, not the call log
